<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אלול_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920460_theRebbe_154" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_9C_D7_95_D7_9C_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920460_theRebbe_154__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that all soul-sparks stand and are elevated to their original source before Hashem, becoming one with Him, and thereby merit a favorable judgment in both spiritual and physical matters for a good year.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is: "You are standing today, all of you," etc.,</t>
    <t s="2">that all the sparks of souls</t>
    <t s="3">(from your heads, your tribes, to the hewer of your wood and drawer of your water)</t>
    <t s="4">stand and are elevated to their first source, until before Hashem,</t>
    <t s="5">and until they become literally one with</t>
    <t s="6">(the aspect of)</t>
    <t s="7">"before Hashem"</t>
    <t s="8">(as above regarding the matter of "passing you into the covenant"),</t>
    <t s="9">[this being] Yisrael and the King alone,</t>
    <t s="10">and through this they also stand</t>
    <t s="11">(according to the explanation of the Baal Shem Tov)</t>
    <t s="12">[meaning] enduring and standing, i.e., they merit [favor] in judgment,</t>
    <t s="13">and not only regarding spiritual matters</t>
    <t s="14">("judgment for the G-d of Yaakov"),</t>
    <t s="15">but also regarding physical matters</t>
    <t s="16">("a statute for Yisrael"),</t>
    <t s="17">and moreover, the main judgment on Rosh HaShanah</t>
    <t s="18">(and that which they merit in judgment)</t>
    <t s="19">is regarding physical matters,</t>
    <t s="20">that each and every one of Yisrael should have a good writing and sealing for a good and sweet year, in the good that is seen and revealed,</t>
    <t s="21">in children, life, and sustenance,</t>
    <t s="22">and in all of them, prosperity.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
